nodes.label: Web Splash Screen Light Mode
nodes.description: AshaSathi app splash screen light-mode variant (available at 1x, 2x, 3x, 4x densities). Displays the 'ASHA SATHI' wordmark in bold green text on a white background. A house icon with a green roof and green-outlined window is integrated into the letter 'H' of 'ASHA', centered above the word 'SATHI'. The design is compact and clean with a single green tone for all elements. Higher density variants (2x, 3x, 4x) are pixel-doubled/tripled/quadrupled versions of the same design for high-DPI screens.
